normative_authority: This contract and its hand fixtures are authoritative for the eleven-method core; no Python, R, Java, Web, koRpus, or quanteda implementation is the sole oracle.

input_contract.unit: one document represented as an ordered sequence of already-tokenized Unicode strings
input_contract.type_equivalence: exact equality of Unicode scalar sequences; canonically equivalent spellings are distinct unless an identified adapter normalized them before entry
input_contract.missing_token_policy: reject the document as invalid_input; do not silently drop NA
input_contract.empty_token_policy: reject the document as invalid_input; a zero-length vector is an empty document, not an empty token
input_contract.encoding_policy: tokens are already-decoded Unicode scalar sequences; reject ambiguous or ill-formed byte input, and do not treat differences in runtime encoding representation as type differences

r.unknown_marker_policy: after validUTF8 succeeds, interpret non-ASCII bytes with an unknown marker as UTF-8 and mark a local copy as UTF-8 before equality/counting
r.mutation: do not mutate the caller's vector
r.normalization: encoding-marker canonicalization only; do not perform Unicode normalization

input_contract.raw_text_adapter: separate and versioned; no raw-text adapter is part of this normative pre-tokenized core

count_symbols.V: number of distinct exact token strings
count_symbols.V_m: number of types occurring exactly m times

batch_envelope.order: input document order, then requested metric order

output_contract.request_validation_policy: metric selection and parameters for every requested metric are structural API inputs and are validated before document-token state; parameters belonging only to unrequested metrics are ignored
output_contract.short_text_policy: strict: never silently reduce a requested segment, window, draw, or fitting range to N
output_contract.parameter_reporting: requested and effective parameters must both be emitted; for an ok result they are identical
output_contract.quality_floor_policy: quality_floor_tokens is an advisory screening flag, not the computational domain and not a justification for changing parameters

r_profile_contract.scope: optional R orchestration over the eleven normative core methods; it does not admit deferred experimental methods or change a core metric result

identity_model.method_id: formula, scale, boundary, tail, and aggregation identity fixed by a metric contract entry
identity_model.specification_id: method identity plus normalized user parameters and metric-contract identity
identity_model.request_id: plan-local join label excluded from computational identity

specification.normalization: materialize every user-settable default in method-defined parameter order; store positive integer-valued parameters as canonical R integers when they do not exceed .Machine$integer.max and as finite doubles otherwise, while non-integer parameters remain finite binary64 numeric scalars
specification.identity_key_serialization: metric_contract_id|metric_contract_version|method_id|parameter_text encoded as UTF-8 without a trailing newline
specification.parameter_serialization: {} for no parameters; otherwise {name=%a;...} in method-defined order, where %a is R sprintf hexadecimal binary64 formatting
specification.specification_id_algorithm: metric_id followed by '-' and the lowercase MD5 hex digest of identity_key UTF-8 bytes
specification.hash_role: deterministic reproducibility label, not authentication; request_id and default_quality_floor_tokens are excluded

request_plan.candidate_bound_policy: reject the total preset, custom-specification, and expanded-grid candidate count above maximum_input_candidates before specification normalization
request_plan.expansion_order: selected presets in request order, then custom specifications, then grids in request order and value order
request_plan.deduplication: collapse equal identity_key values before execution; first occurrence wins and order is otherwise preserved
request_plan.request_id_policy: after deduplication, replace a missing request_id with specification_id
request_plan.request_id_uniqueness: distinct resolved specifications must have distinct request_id values
request_plan.hash_input: schema_id, schema_version, and the ordered hash records joined with LF, with one LF between each of the three parts and no trailing LF
request_plan.hash_algorithm: lowercase MD5 hex digest of the hash_input UTF-8 bytes
request_plan.construction_metadata_identity: presets and max_specs are retained construction metadata but are excluded from plan_md5; the resolved specifications, request IDs, and order are authoritative

grid_builder.dimensionality: one user-settable method parameter per grid
grid_builder.expansion: one specification per supplied value in input order; no implicit Cartesian product
grid_builder.bound_policy: reject length(values) greater than max_values before specification expansion; max_values is a positive finite integer and must be raised explicitly by the caller

presets.resolution: one default specification for every freeze-ready metric in contract order
canonical followed by the two additions in listed order

r_profile_contract.mtld_length_screen_policy: 50 and 100 tokens are quality or evidence screens, not MTLD estimation parameters; length_50_100 contains exactly one MTLD specification

profile_envelope.composition: envelope_fields followed by the unchanged core result_fields
profile_envelope.single_document_order: one result per resolved specification in one-based request_index order
profile_envelope.batch_composition: batch envelope_fields followed by profile envelope_fields followed by core result_fields
profile_envelope.batch_order: input document order, then request_index order
profile_envelope.batch_bound_policy: reject document count multiplied by resolved specification count above max_rows before profile computation; max_rows is a positive finite integer
profile_envelope.quality_floor_semantics: default_quality_floor_tokens equals the metric contract entry and is advisory; changing a user parameter does not change this field

screen_result.bound_policy: reject source-row count multiplied by screen count above max_rows before allocating result rows; max_rows is a positive finite integer
screen_result.expansion_order: source profile row order, then caller-supplied screen order
screen_result.screen_identity: screen_id values are unique plain identifiers and minimum_tokens values are positive finite integers
screen_result.pass_rule: passes_screen is N >= minimum_tokens when N is known
screen_result.unknown_rule: passes_screen is missing if and only if N is missing
screen_result.no_value_policy: screen results contain no metric value column
screen_result.effect_policy: screening never changes, suppresses, or duplicates a metric value, parameter, status, or source profile row
screen_result.label_semantics: caller-supplied screen labels are descriptive thresholds and do not by themselves assert empirical validity or evidence compatibility

metrics.label: Type-token ratio
metrics.construct: observed lexical variety relative to tokens

definition.log_base: any common base; the ratio is invariant

definition.variant: a-squared; do not take the square root

metrics.label: Mean segmental TTR
metrics.construct: mean local variety in fixed non-overlapping segments

algorithm: start the first segment at token 1
partition into consecutive non-overlapping segments of segment_length
discard the final remainder without shifting or padding
return the arithmetic mean of segment TTR values

metrics.label: Moving-average TTR
metrics.construct: mean local variety in all fixed overlapping windows

algorithm: use every consecutive window of window_length
advance exactly one token per window
include both the first and last possible complete window
return the arithmetic mean of the N-window_length+1 window TTR values

metrics.label: Measure of textual lexical diversity
metrics.construct: mean tokens per sequential factor at a TTR threshold

directional_algorithm: scan non-overlapping sequential factors from the first token
close a complete factor only when its length is at least 10 and its unrounded running TTR is strictly less than threshold
after closure start an empty factor at the next token
for a non-empty final tail add tail_credit=(1-tail_TTR)/(1-threshold) without rounding or clamping
directional score is N/(complete_factors+tail_credit) when the denominator is positive
definition.bidirectional_aggregation: compute N/F separately in forward and reversed order, then take their arithmetic mean; do not pool factor counts
definition.variant_boundaries: the current Python <= variant and koRpus no-minimum variant are distinct methods
definition.taa_led_identity_limit: this corresponds to the direction-score form commonly exposed as mtldo; any TAALED compatibility claim must pin the exact function/version

computational_domain.condition: N >= 10 and both directional factor denominators are positive

metrics.label: HD-D on expected-TTR scale
metrics.construct: expected TTR of a uniform sample without replacement

definition.formula: sum_t(1 - choose(N - f_t, sample_size) / choose(N, sample_size)) / sample_size
definition.zero_combination_convention: choose(a,b)=0 when b>a for non-negative integers
definition.variant: divide expected types by sample_size; this is not raw expected-types HD-D
type-based denominator M2-V; not an algebraic inverse of Yule K
